title: Chromatic sampler
description: Six graphic pads invert their ink, depress on contact and play six distinct synthesized notes.
useCase: Immediate musical feedback for playable brand identities, creative toys and compact sample pads.
interaction: Press a pad, use keys 1–6, or toggle sound.
reducedMotion: Graphic ink inversion remains immediate; press displacement is removed. Audio still plays after a user gesture.
limitations: Sound is armed initially and starts on the first pad gesture, subject to browser audio support. Six synthesized pitches, not recorded samples or a sequencer.
look: Six flat saturated colour tiles in a black-gridded two-row layout, each with a bold geometric glyph, small note label and name, under an off-white header.
motion: Pressing a pad or keys 1–6 nudges its face 5 px down-right in 110 ms and inverts its colours for 180 ms while Web Audio plays a short synthesized note.
adapt: Pad data lives in `PADS` (name, note, `hz`, colours, `wave`); `play` starts an oscillator with an 8 ms attack and 0.44 s exponential decay and holds `pressed` for 180 ms. The press offset is `translate(5px,5px)` on `.sf-cs-face`; replace glyphs and names.
